question: What single GF(2) predicate, beyond the odd-weight stabilizer, remains invariant under every basis change that also preserves the current residue?

responses_summary.grok:
The setting is the vector space \(\mathbb{F}_2^n\) equipped with the standard (odd-weight) linear functional
\[
\sigma(x)=\sum_ix_i\in\mathbb{F}_2.
\]
A change-of-basis matrix \(A\in\mathrm{GL}(n,2)\)
responses_summary.sibling-beta: the non-vanishing trace of the central involution

sibling_exchange.content: the non-vanishing trace of the central involution
